What we offer

Everything you need to succeed in finance

From your first stock pitch to your first internship offer — UFA is with you every step of the way.

Professional networking

Weekly meetings featuring a market watch, corporate speaker, and food. Our partners span IB, PE, consulting, asset management, and real estate.

Hands-on learning

Opportunities for stock pitches, case competitions, financial modeling sessions, mock interviews, and market watch discussions that go well beyond the classroom.

Leadership & growth

Give back to UFA through on executive board roles - lead our analysts, contact our speakers, market our organization, manage our budget.

Our mission

“ To empower the next generation of financial leaders at UT Austin by providing unparalleled opportunities for professional development, technical education, and industry connection. ”

About UFA

The oldest McCombs-affiliated organization on campus

As UT Austin’s founding finance organization, UFA is a cornerstone of the McCombs community since 1951. Decades later, our mission remains unchanged: to provide a welcoming, high-impact environment where any student can explore their curiosity about finance.

Join UFA today

Programs

Three Teams,
Two Paths,
One Community.

Entry-level · One round of applications

Analyst Program

The Analyst Program serves as the foundation for your journey in UFA. Designed for underclassmen and new members, the program offers an additional weekly meeting beyond the general member meeting — giving you more opportunities to get involved and meet new people.

Sessions are lecture-based, led by our Directors of Investment and Consulting, and focus on building technical knowledge in accounting, valuation, modeling, market analysis, problem-solving, and strategy.

Apply to Analyst Program
Explore Both Paths

Gain exposure to high-finance and consulting through weekly lectures and assignments that build knowledge from the ground up.

Engage and Apply

Participate in stock pitches, case-style exercises, and hands-on projects — turning technical concepts to practical experience.

Grow Your Network

Connect with a community of like-minded peers while receiving insights on recruiting, resume formatting, and networking.

Selective · Investment track

Investment Team

The UFA Investment Associate Program is dedicated to providing tangible skills, building networks, and preparing members for recruiting — all within an ambitious and collaborative community.

Through hands-on learning and mentorship, we provide experiences in portfolio management, financial modeling, and equity research. By fostering collaboration and growth, we help our members build lasting friendships.

Apply to Investment Associates
Mentorship

Get paired with UFA upperclassmen who mentor you throughout the year — guiding and teaching you what they wished they knew when they were in your shoes.

Market Watch

Dive deep into technicals, track economic trends, and discuss major news weekly. These sessions sharpen your ability to think critically about financial developments.

Stock Pitch

Build and present stock pitches by industry. Research the company in-depth, develop theses points, model cash flosws, analyze risk, and compile research into our published journal.

Program Core Competencies

01

Active Fund Management

Experience real-world portfolio management by analyzing market trends and pitching actionable investment strategies.

02

Modeling Practice

Master Excel-based financial modeling, including DCF analysis, comparable company analysis, and LBO modeling.

03

Equity Research

Contribute to our flagship publication. Analysts perform deep-dives into public companies for our semesterly report.

04

Applied Learning

Bridge the gap between the classroom and the industry with case studies designed to simulate real finance roles.

05

Leadership Roles

Take on responsibility early. Our members lead project teams and manage external firm relations.

06

Recruiting Support

Access specialized resources for technical interview prep and networking strategies for high-finance placements.

Selective · Consulting track

Consulting Team

The UFA Consulting Associate Program equips members with the frameworks, communication skills, and business acumen needed to excel in competitive consulting roles — all within a driven and collaborative environment.

Through case-based learning and mentorship, we provide hands-on experience in strategic analysis, client communication, and structured problem-solving. By building both technical and interpersonal skills, we prepare members for top consulting placements.

Apply to Consulting Associates Work with us
Case Coaching

Practice live case interviews with experienced upperclassmen. Sharpen your structured thinking and communication under realistic interview conditions.

Industry Deep Dives

Explore consulting frameworks applied to real industries. Sessions cover market sizing, competitive analysis, and strategic recommendations.

Client Simulations

Build and present consulting deliverables to simulated clients. Develop slide decks, synthesize findings, and defend your recommendations.

Explore Both Paths

Gain exposure to high-finance and consulting through weekly lectures and assignments that build knowledge from the ground up.

Engage and Apply

Grow Your Network

Everything you need to know

Got questions? We've got answers.

Analysts meet weekly to build technical skills, explore different career paths, and connect with peers in a collaborative environment. Members write news stories, present to the class, and may be published on our weekly blog.

Associates form a smaller, tight-knit group that meets more frequently to prepare for interviews and gain hands-on experience in stock pitching or pro bono consulting. Associates have access to a wide alumni network, one-on-one mentorship, and impressive placement outcomes.

No — you must be a general member and pay dues in order to attend regular UFA events. General membership is open year-round with no application required.
Every Wednesday from 5–6 PM in the McCombs building. Follow our Instagram for the exact room number each week.
You can become a general member at any time. For associates and analysts, recruitment happens at the beginning of fall and spring semesters. Follow our Instagram @texasufa for updates on exact dates.
Be your authentic self. Show up to info sessions, meet the team, and express your genuine interests in your application. We look for drive and curiosity — not a perfect GPA or prior finance experience.
$45 per semester or $75 for the full academic year. After joining on HornsLink, pay dues via Venmo @TEXASUFA25.
Yes — we host over 50 events annually, ranging from pickleball tournaments to lake barges. Socials are a fantastic way to network and meet people across all teams. They're also a lot of fun.
Not at all. UFA is open to all UT Austin students regardless of major. We have members from CS, Economics, Liberal Arts, Engineering, and more. A genuine interest in finance is what matters.
General members attend one weekly meeting on Wednesdays from 5–6 PM. Analysts and Associates have an additional weekly program meeting each week. Board members commit additional hours for leadership responsibilities.
General meetings are held every Wednesday from 5–6 PM at the McCombs School of Business. Meetings feature a market watch, a corporate speaker, and food — open to all members.
